description: Check phone number for fraud risk — detects VOIP, prepaid, risky numbers, carrier info, line type (mobile/landline/VOIP), active status, leaked data. Returns fraud score (0-100) and geographic location. Supports international numbers with country filter (IPQualityScore)

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code for national format numbers (e.g. "US", "GB")

phone.description: Phone number to check in E.164 or national format (e.g. "+12125551234", "2125551234")

name: security.ipqs.phone_check

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Phone Number Fraud Detection
